spots.name: Nuyakuk Lake
spots.tip: A lake: calm air at dawn gives mirror reflections, and mist often sits on the water on cold mornings. The pin marks the middle of the lake: pick a shore spot facing the light.

spots.name: Dillingham
spots.tip: eBird birding hotspot with 122 species recorded. Birds are most active in the first two hours after sunrise; recent sightings at ebird.org/hotspot/L983274.
